import tensorflow as tf,pickle,numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score
x=pickle.load(open('/tmp/inputs/X.pkl','rb')); y=pickle.load(open('/tmp/inputs/y.pkl','rb'))
base=tf.keras.applications.MobileNetV2(input_shape=(96,96,3),include_top=False,weights='imagenet',pooling='avg')
def feat(a): return base(tf.keras.applications.mobilenet_v2.preprocess_input(tf.image.resize(a,(96,96))),training=False).numpy()
z=feat(x)
# augmentation features flip
zf=feat(x[:,:,::-1]); za=np.r_[z,zf]; ya=np.r_[y,y]
for C in [1,3,10,30,100]:
 vals=[]
 for tr,va in StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=3).split(z,y):
  # only original train plus flipped
  inds=np.r_[tr,tr+len(y)]; m=SVC(C=C);m.fit(za[inds],ya[inds]); vals.append(accuracy_score(y[va],m.predict(z[va])))
 print(C,vals,np.mean(vals))
EOF
